content.value: Derive the perspective projection matrix. In a perspective projection matrices with $\scriptstyle z _ { 0 } = 6$ scene point (-20,8,15) projects to what $( \mathbf { x } , \mathbf { y } )$ point on the virtual image plane? To what (x,y) point on the real image plane?
